apiNamedQueryParameters.description: Salesforce Id of the Account to list Contacts for

ApiNamedQuery.body2: SELECT Id, Name, Email, Title, AccountId FROM Contact WHERE AccountId = :accountid ORDER BY Name
ApiNamedQuery.description: Lists every Contact on an Account -- name, email, title. No "primary contact" designation is returned -- most orgs have no reliable field/data for it (OpportunityContactRole often unused; AccountContactRelation often not enabled).
